The codes that govern every 3D LiDAR Scanning engagement.

3D LiDAR Scanning runs the international standards stack with country-native regulatory overlays applied per jurisdiction.

Hazardous Area
Class I Div 2 + Zone 2 deployment

Intrinsically-safe field deployment protocols for refinery, petrochem, and upstream Class I Div 2 / Zone 2 hazardous areas. ATEX-certified equipment where required.

Survey Accuracy
ISO 17123 + ISO 19157

ISO 17123 field test for survey instrument accuracy. ISO 19157 data quality framework. 1.9 mm @ 10 m typical RTC360 single-point accuracy.

Registration
Cyclone REGISTER 360

Multi-scan registration workflow. Cloud-to-cloud + target-based registration. Sub-millimetre cumulative registration error on plant-scale captures.

Data Format
E57 + RCP + LAS + PTS

Industry-standard point cloud format export. E57 ISO 17841 standard. RCP for Autodesk workflow. LAS / PTS for legacy CAD compatibility.

Photography
HDR imagery + 360° panoramic

HDR true-colour imagery overlay. 360° panoramic capture for spherical viewing in Cyclone + ReCap.

Sign-Off
CEng MIE + Survey Lead

Chartered Engineer signature on point cloud quality + registration accuracy. Survey Lead sign-off on coordinate system + georeferencing.

Common questions about 3D LiDAR Scanning.

Why Leica RTC360 as the main platform?

RTC360 delivers 2,000,000 points per second, 1.9 mm @ 10 m single-point accuracy, intrinsically-safe field deployment for Class I Div 2 / Zone 2 hazardous areas, and native HDR imagery + 360° panoramic capture. Cyclone REGISTER 360 registration workflow is the production standard.

How long does a typical plant capture take?

5,000 m² unit: 3 days field + 1 week registration. 50,000 m² plant: 3 weeks field + 4 weeks registration. 500,000 m² refinery: 3 months total. Field-team scheduler engaged within 48 hours of first contact.

What output formats do you provide?

Native E57 (ISO 17841), RCP (Autodesk), LAS / PTS (legacy CAD), and HDR panoramic 360° imagery. Cleaned + structured for native digital twin handover. Custom format export on request.

Can you scan in hazardous areas?

Yes. Class I Div 2 / Zone 2 deployment protocols. ATEX-certified equipment where required. Hot work permit coordination with site EHS. Hyderabad + Houston field teams trained on hazardous-area protocols.

How does LiDAR bundle with As-Built and Digital Twin?

LiDAR capture → As-Built drawing creation (P&ID / Iso / SLD / GA) → Digital Twin foundation handover to digital twin. Single-engagement bundles available with continuous CEng oversight. Most-common bundle: LiDAR + As-Built across 3,000+ km of P&ID delivered to date.
